name: Temporal mismatch
detail: Transfer proposed in Sept 2026; 2025 relaxation window was 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025; ban in force, no relaxation for 2026.

name: Procedural / wrong authority
detail: Proposes approval by Deputy Secretary; competent authority for Senior Assistant transfer is the Secretary to Government.

name: Missing authority
detail: Cites G.O.Ms.No.104, Finance (HR.I) Dept., Dt.02-01-2026 — not present in the corpus.

name: Direct rule contradiction
detail: Proposes exceeding the 15% ceiling 'as a special case'; G.O.Ms.No.31 forbids relaxation without FD concurrence.

name: Precedent inconsistency
detail: Comparable 2023 out-of-window spouse request was not agreed while the ban was in force.

name: Hierarchy conflict
detail: Relies on a Circular Memo (Rs.1.50 crore) that contradicts the higher G.O.Ms.No.27/2024 (Rs.1.00 crore for emergency works).

name: Procedural / wrong authority
detail: Works above Rs.1.00 crore are to be sanctioned by the Government only.

name: Precedent inconsistency
detail: 2024 emergency work of Rs.1.40 crore was sanctioned by Government; 2023 Rs.1.20 crore by Commissioner predates G.O.Ms.No.27.

name: Temporal mismatch
detail: Relies on G.O.Rt.No.1184/2025, whose validity ended on 31-03-2026.

name: Procedural / missing concurrence
detail: Continuation without prior Finance Department concurrence, contrary to G.O.Ms.No.40/2020.

name: Hierarchy conflict (standing)
detail: Circular Memo of 2023 was never withdrawn but now contradicts G.O.Ms.No.27/2024.
